title: VitisGP: Multi-Task Benchmark for Genotype to Phenotype Grapevine Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.40668v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As climate change reshapes grape-growing conditions, predicting grapevine phenotypes from genomic variation is increasingly important for identifying and breeding cultivars suited to emerging environmental pressures. Existing research on the grapevine genotype-phenotype relationship using machine learning has often focused on individual traits, isolated regions, or a limited set of predictive models. We introduce VitisGP, a multi-phenotype curated dataset, integrating genome-wide SNP data with 26 heterogeneous phenotype prediction tasks spanning sommelier-curated aroma traits (N=11), botanical traits (N=14) and wine color---across 1,197 Vitis vinifera cultivars. translated_title: VitisGP：葡萄基因型到表型预测的多任务基准数据集
translated_abstract: 随着气候变化不断改变葡萄种植条件，从基因组变异预测葡萄表型对于识别和培育能够适应新环境压力的品种变得日益重要。现有利用机器学习研究葡萄基因型-表型关系的工作，往往只关注单一性状、孤立地区或有限的预测模型。我们提出了VitisGP，一个经过精心整理的多表型数据集，将全基因组SNP数据与26个异构表型预测任务相结合，涵盖由侍酒师整理的香气性状（N=11）、植物学性状（N=14）以及葡萄酒颜色，共涉及1,197个欧亚种葡萄品种。我们利用VitisGP对表型预测进行基准测试，比较了具有不同归纳偏置的机器学习模型，包括L2正则化逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、CatBoost、GBLUP以及基于Transformer的模型，提供了对该基准的首次系统性比较。
tldr: 该论文提出了VitisGP——一个将全基因组SNP数据与26个异构表型预测任务整合、覆盖1,197个欧亚种葡萄品种的多表型基准数据集，并首次系统比较了多种具有不同归纳偏置的机器学习模型在葡萄基因型到表型预测任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VitisGP, a curated multi-phenotype benchmark integrating genome-wide SNP data with 26 heterogeneous phenotype prediction tasks across 1,197 Vitis vinifera cultivars, and provides the first systematic comparison of machine-learning models with diverse inductive biases for genotype-to-phenotype grapevine prediction.
